messages:
naomi: deploy-bot flagged a post-deploy synth failure in eu-west-1 for /embed. p95 spike to 503s, seems limited to quantized-variant (quant2). can we triage and decide pin/rollback?

deploy-bot: [automated] Deploy 2026-03-23T12:34Z -> stable. Postdeploy synthetic check FAILED: route=/embed, model=embed-quant2, region=eu-west-1 (503 x 27 / 90 checks)
alex: on it, pulling runtime logs now. quick q — any user-facing errors seen?
sara: only synthetic failures so far, prod error rate unchanged. synthetic success dropped to ~65% for that route.
alex: runtime shows repeated GC/OOM on quant2 hosts during warmup window, host restarts around rollout. sounds like quant2 memory path triggered.
ryan: suggestion: regional pin the embed route in eu-west-1 back to model:embed-v2@2026-03-22 (non-quant) while we investigate. keep other regions using the quant variant.
naomi: agreed — regional pin reduces blast radius. can we do it via routing override?
sara: yes, routing policy supports this. command: `rk route pin --region eu-west-1 --route /embed --model embed-v2@2026-03-22`
alex: executing the pin and scaling down quant2 pool in eu-west to 0% to avoid new allocations. will report when propagation completes.
deploy-bot: [automated] Routing policy update request received from alex. Propagation estimated ~45s.
sara: monitoring synth probe now. if success restores >95% we keep pin and file RCA ticket. fallback plan: full global rollback to deploy id 20260323-2345 if other regressions surface.
naomi: synth success rate back to 98% within 2 minutes of pin. folding this into release notes and support blurb. opening INC-4521 for quant2 OOM RCA.
alex: left a note in release changelog: "Hotfix: regional pin applied to /embed in eu-west-1 due to post-deploy synthetic failures on quantized variant; investigation ongoing." any objections?
ryan: lgtm :thumbsup:
sara: I'll add the pin details to the deploy window doc and notify support.
naomi: marking thread resolved for now. will reopen if RCA suggests broader action.
